description: Complete atlas of the playable area and exact 600 m scenery ring, preserving the actual source revision of every frame, with separately labelled distant context.
coverageNote: Every 250 m grid cell intersecting the runtime playable mask or exact analytic 600 m ring is included. This describes capture coverage only; it is not a fidelity score. Boundary cells also contain land outside the ring.
reviewNote: All90 actual game/reference pairs reviewed with explicit source/visual gaps;25 current water retakes plus65 unchanged original image bytes. Coverage is complete; real-world parity remains incomplete.

review.status: All90 actual game/reference pairs reviewed with explicit source/visual gaps;25 current water retakes plus65 unchanged original image bytes. Coverage is complete; real-world parity remains incomplete.
review.comparisonMethod: Private georeferenced Esri crop at each exact250m north-up ground square; actual source/image/sheet hashes retained per frame. Roof parallax and unknown reference acquisition are not source measurements. Reference imagery is not published.
remainingGaps: Circus lobed roof lacks its detailed authored model; no invented dimensions/catalogue entry added.
